restaurantName: Khao Soi Lung Prakit Kad Kom
address: 53 Suriyawongse Road, Hai Ya, Mueang Chiang Mai, Chiang Mai, 50100, Thailand
bio: This place has been serving Northern Thai-style curry noodle soup for over 40 years. Their signature dish is Khao Soi with beef, which features a savoury curry broth and soft, eggy noodles. Don’t forget to squeeze the lemon over your noodles and pair them with side dishes to enhance the flavours....
